Alejandro Tejero de la Morena

Telematics Engineer - Intern at Bosch

Interning at BoschMadrid, SpainEnglish B1, working towards B2

I'm a Telecommunications Engineer specialized in Telematics from Universidad Rey Juan Carlos. Since early in my degree I've been drawn to systems and backend development, and over time that interest has grown into AI-driven automation and cybersecurity, two fields I think will shape how software gets built over the next few years.

I'm currently an engineering intern at Bosch, where I analyze large volumes of production data to spot patterns and propose process improvements, design databases and queries, and build Power BI dashboards to track KPIs. It's the first time I've applied what I learned during my degree to a real industrial setting, and it's helped me understand how data analysis and software engineering fit together at production scale.

Outside of Bosch, my personal and academic projects lean more towards backend development with Python and Django, client-server systems and generative AI automation, like WebBuilder, my final thesis project. I like to really understand what I'm doing before calling it done, pay attention to detail, and leave things well documented for whoever picks them up next, including future me.
